column2: THE ASSISTANCE AND PROTECTION PROGRAMME FOR VICTIMS OF

57.
(1)  The  Authority  shall,  in  consultation  with  the
Protection  Division  and  based  on  the  guidelines  to  be
developed  by  the  Authority,  draw  up  an  Assistance  and
Protection  General  Programme  for  Victims  of  Crime  and
Witnesses  containing  the  procedure  for  the  provision  of
assistance and protection to victims of crime and  witnesses
(in this Act referred to as the “General Programme”).
